# Brand survey for lavaan's single-group rules: NA frees a first
# indicator (no marker; the factor's variance is fixed instead), a
# labelled first indicator stays the marker (fixed to 1), two
# endogenous factors with a residual covariance, and a residual
# covariance between items (lavaan's std.all divides a residual
# covariance by the residual variances).
quality =~ NA*q1 + q2 + q3
quality ~~ 1*quality
value =~ m*v1 + v2 + v3
service =~ s1 + s2 + s3
value ~ quality
service ~ quality
value ~~ service
q1 ~~ v1
recommend ~ quality + value + service
